backup_parent_matches_type.name: backup_parent_matches_type
backup_parent_matches_type.value:
num_nonnulls("compose_id", "postgres_id", "mariadb_id", "mysql_id", "mongo_id", "libsql_id") = 1
    AND (CASE
           WHEN "backup_type" = 'compose'     THEN "compose_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'postgres'  THEN "postgres_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'mariadb'   THEN "mariadb_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'mysql'     THEN "mysql_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'mongo'     THEN "mongo_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'libsql'    THEN "libsql_id"
         END) IS NOT NULL

mount_parent_matches_service_type.name: mount_parent_matches_service_type
mount_parent_matches_service_type.value:
num_nonnulls("application_id", "compose_id", "libsql_id", "mariadb_id", "mongo_id", "mysql_id", "postgres_id", "redis_id") = 1
    AND (CASE "service_type"
           WHEN 'application' THEN "application_id"
           WHEN 'compose'     THEN "compose_id"
           WHEN 'libsql'      THEN "libsql_id"
           WHEN 'mariadb'     THEN "mariadb_id"
           WHEN 'mongo'       THEN "mongo_id"
           WHEN 'mysql'       THEN "mysql_id"
           WHEN 'postgres'    THEN "postgres_id"
           WHEN 'redis'       THEN "redis_id"
         END) IS NOT NULL

schedule_parent_matches_schedule_type.name: schedule_parent_matches_schedule_type
schedule_parent_matches_schedule_type.value:
num_nonnulls("application_id", "compose_id", "server_id", "organization_id") = 1
    AND (CASE "schedule_type"
           WHEN 'application'      THEN "application_id"
           WHEN 'compose'          THEN "compose_id"
           WHEN 'server'           THEN "server_id"
           WHEN 'cloudgate-server' THEN "organization_id"
         END) IS NOT NULL
